title: verify_user_authentication_and_route_protection
description: Test the user authentication process including login and session management. Verify that route protection correctly restricts access based on authentication status and user roles.

title: validate_pos_sales_transaction_processing
description: Test the Point of Sale interface for processing sales transactions, including fractional quantities, price overrides with role validation, and tax calculations. Ensure transactions are completed within two minutes on mobile devices.

title: test_inventory_management_and_traceability
description: Verify inventory tracking including quantity, weight, and cost per unit. Ensure immutable historical intake and adjustment records are maintained and audit logs are generated for inventory changes.

title: check_customer_profile_management_and_soft_disable
description: Test customer profile creation, purchase history aggregation, and the soft-disable functionality. Ensure customers are not deleted but only soft-disabled and that data integrity is maintained.

title: validate_role_based_access_control_enforcement
description: Verify that role-based permissions for Cashier, Supervisor, Manager, and Super Admin are enforced server-side and at the database level, preventing unauthorized actions regardless of UI controls.

title: test_audit_log_generation_for_sensitive_actions
description: Ensure that all sensitive actions such as price overrides, inventory adjustments, voids/refunds, and permission changes generate immutable audit logs that cannot be altered or deleted.

title: verify_tax_and_pricing_calculation_accuracy
description: Test deterministic pricing and tax logic with configurable tax rules and explicit rounding rules. Validate that calculations are reproducible and transparent across different scenarios.

title: validate_mobile_pos_usability_and_performance
description: Test the mobile-optimized POS interface for usability with one-hand operation and ensure new staff can complete a sale within two minutes under typical conditions.

title: check_immutable_transaction_and_inventory_records
description: Verify that all transaction and inventory records are immutable or append-only, preventing silent data mutations and ensuring historical data remains trustworthy.

title: test_ai_powered_credit_engine_integration
description: Validate the AI-powered credit engine's integration with the core system, including credit limit calculations and credit analysis accuracy.
